# glpi_manufacturer (Data Source)

Looks up A GLPI manufacturer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_manufacturer" "by_name" {
  name = "example"
}

data "glpi_manufacturer" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Name of the item. Set id or name; the name must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
